title: Design an ATM
relevance: High — canonical State + Chain-of-Responsibility LLD / machine-coding question (campus + experienced); especially common at fintech / payments loops (Paytm, PhonePe, Razorpay, Visa, banks) and product cos probing FSM modeling, hardware orchestration, and transactional safety.
company_notes: Campus/machine-coding (Flipkart, Uber, Swiggy, Amazon new-grad, Indian product cos): common design+code in 90 min where working State FSM + withdraw/deposit beats a half-finished pattern zoo. Fintech/payments/banks (Paytm, PhonePe, Razorpay, Visa, GS/JPM-style): especially frequent; expect PIN lockout, atomic debit/dispense, and denomination COR probes. Experienced LLD (FAANG / Atlassian / Microsoft): same core with deeper concurrency, failure-reversal, and extensibility; often paired with vending machine (State) and parking lot. Top-tier canonical LLD — the State + COR showcase after parking lot and vending machine.

phases.goal: Lock mandatory FRs, common extensions, NFRs, and scale assumptions before drawing the FSM or classes.

must_hit.point: Mandatory FR: authenticate via card + PIN; balance inquiry; cash withdrawal (check balance + ATM cash); cash deposit; eject/cancel ends session.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Lists card+PIN auth, balance, withdraw with both checks, deposit, and eject/cancel ending the session.

must_hit.point: Clarify extensions before coding: transfer; mini-statement; PIN change; daily withdrawal limit; operator refill; receipt print; Checking vs Savings selection; denominations & greedy largest-first; PIN retry / card retain; one user at a time; simulate bank vs real network.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Asks clarifying questions on which txns, denominations, PIN lockout, daily limits, and bank simulation rather than silently assuming.

must_hit.point: NFR: correct state transitions; no debit without successful dispense (or auto-reversal); thread-safe account + inventory; extensible states/denominations/txns; working demo / CLI.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Mentions FSM correctness, debit/dispense safety with reversal, concurrency, extensibility, and a runnable demo.

must_hit.point: State assumptions: one customer at a time per machine; fixed denominations; bank simulated in-memory; no multi-currency unless asked; use cases include wrong PIN ×3 → card blocked and ATM out of notes → refuse withdrawal but allow balance.
must_hit.evidence_hint: States single-session machine, in-memory bank, fixed denominations, and the PIN×3 / out-of-notes use cases.

probes: What clarifying questions do you ask before drawing classes?
Which transactions are in scope for v1, and what happens after 3 wrong PINs?

hints.1: Start from customer and operator use cases, not patterns.
hints.2: Separate mandatory FR (auth, balance, withdraw, deposit, eject) from extensions (transfer, mini-statement, daily limit, refill, receipt).
hints.3: Say: one customer per machine; fixed denominations; in-memory bank; PIN×3 locks/retains card; out of notes refuses withdraw but allows balance.

phases.goal: Name the domain objects and who owns session state, money movement, and physical cash.

must_hit.point: Core entities: ATM / ATMSystem (context + Facade); ATMState hierarchy; Card; Account; BankService / BankNetwork; CashDispenser + denomination chain; Transaction hierarchy (Withdraw / Deposit / BalanceInquiry).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Names ATM context, states, Card, Account, BankService, CashDispenser/chain, and Transaction types — not one god class.

must_hit.point: Optional hardware ports: CardReader, Keypad, Screen, Printer, DepositSlot — ATM orchestrates them; BankService is authority for balances; Dispenser is the physical cash constraint separate from account balance.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Separates hardware I/O, bank money authority, and dispenser inventory responsibilities.

must_hit.point: Session model: one physical ATM → one active card/session; card stays until cancel/eject; cancel anytime → eject + Idle; PIN attempt counter lives on session/state, not sprinkled through ATM methods.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Describes single active session, eject-on-cancel, and attempt counter scoped to session/state.

must_hit.point: Money units: prefer integer minor units (cents/paise) in production; demos often use int dollars — never rely on double equality for cash math.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Rejects double for cash; uses int minor units or int dollars with that caveat.

probes: What are the main entities and who owns balances vs cash inventory vs session state?
Where does the PIN attempt counter live?

hints.1: List nouns from the happy path: ATM, card, account, bank, dispenser, transaction.
hints.2: ATM is Facade+context; states own legality; BankService owns balances; CashDispenser owns notes.
hints.3: Sketch ATM → ATMState + BankService + CashDispenser(COR) + Card/Account; optional CardReader/Keypad/Screen/Printer; attempt counter on session/state.

phases.goal: Draw Facade + State + COR so transitions and note handling live in pluggable types, not a giant switch.

must_hit.point: ATMSystem / ATM holds currentState, currentCard, bankService, cashDispenser; exposes insertCard / enterPin / selectOperation / ejectCard that delegate to state, plus changeState; ATM must not become a giant if/else on state.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Shows context fields and state-delegated public API with changeState, not nested state×op switches.

must_hit.point: ATMState interface defines insertCard / enterPin / selectOperation / ejectCard; concrete IdleState | HasCardState | AuthenticatedState | (OutOfServiceState); each state implements valid behavior and calls atm.changeState(...).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Lists the state interface methods and concrete states with transitions inside states.

must_hit.point: CashDispenser wraps DispenseChain; NoteDispenser chain e.g. NoteDispenser100 → 50 → 20 (or NoteDispenser2000 → 500 → 200 → 100 / $100→$50→$20→$10); BankService holds accounts/cards maps with authenticate / getBalance / withdrawMoney / depositMoney; optional Transaction as Command.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Shows COR dispenser hierarchy linked to BankService APIs and optional Transaction Command types.

probes: Walk me through the class diagram and where state transitions live.
How is the cash dispenser structured?

hints.1: Draw Idle → HasCard → Authenticated → Dispensing → Idle before naming classes.
hints.2: Facade delegates to ATMState; CashDispenser sits beside BankService as COR.
hints.3: ATMState with Idle/HasCard/Authenticated; NoteDispenser100→50→20 chain; BankService for PIN/balance/debit; Transaction optional Command.

phases.goal: Implement FSM behavior, PIN lockout, COR dispense with dry-run, and debit/dispense with reversal on failure.

must_hit.point: Happy path FSM: Idle → HasCard (PIN) → Authenticated → (Processing/Dispensing) → Idle; invalid actions reject / no-op — never allow withdraw from Idle.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Narrates legal transitions and explicit reject for illegal ops like withdraw while Idle.

must_hit.point: PIN security: max 3 attempts → lock/retain card → reset to Idle; reset attempts on success.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Implements attempt counting with lock/retain after 3 failures and Idle after eject.

must_hit.point: COR cash: each cassette num = min(amount/denom, stock), reduce stock, forward remainder; dry-run canDispense before debiting the account.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Describes per-denom cassette math, remainder forwarding, and canDispense before any debit.

must_hit.point: Validation-before-commit: check account balance, ATM inventory / canDispense, optional daily limit — then debit; if hardware dispense fails → credit back / reverse.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Orders balance + canDispense (+ daily limit) before debit and names reversal on dispense failure.

probes: Walk through withdrawCash from Authenticated state end to end.
What happens if the dispenser jams after the account was debited?

hints.1: Code Idle → HasCard → Authenticated happy path before extensions.
hints.2: canDispense dry-run, then debit, then dispense; reverse on hardware fail.
hints.3: COR largest-first with stock; PIN×3 lock/retain; withdrawCash = canDispense → debit → dispense with try/catch reverse.

phases.goal: Show OCP hooks for new states, denominations, and transaction types without rewriting ATM.

must_hit.point: State pattern over enum-switch for OCP: adding OutOfService / Maintenance / CardBlocked should not edit a giant switch in ATM; each new state is a class.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Prefers State classes so new modes plug in without touching a central switch.

must_hit.point: Add ₹200 notes or a new txn type via new NoteDispenser link in chain / new Transaction + operation enum — no edit to IdleState; OCP = new state / denomination / transaction type without editing ATM.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Adds denomination or txn as new types/links without changing IdleState or the ATM god switch.

must_hit.point: SOLID: SRP = state owns transitions, dispenser owns notes, bank owns balances; DIP = depend on ATMState / DispenseChain / BankService abstractions; Singleton OK for one physical machine demo, prefer DI for tests / multi-ATM fleets.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Maps SRP/DIP to concrete abstractions and qualifies Singleton with DI for tests/fleets.

probes: How would you add OutOfService or a new denomination without rewriting ATM?

hints.1: Ask what should change without editing the Facade.
hints.2: New behavior → new State, NoteDispenser link, or Transaction — not more ifs.
hints.3: OutOfServiceState / CardBlocked as states; new NoteDispenser in COR; Singleton only for one machine demo, inject for tests/fleets.

phases.goal: Keep the physical ATM single-session while making BankService accounts and CashDispenser inventory safe under contention.

must_hit.point: Physical ATM is usually single-user (session lock), but BankService accounts and CashDispenser inventory must be thread-safe if claiming concurrent ATMs or admin refill mid-session.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Separates single-user session from synchronized account and dispenser inventory.

must_hit.point: Hot path = canDispense + debit + dispense under contention → synchronized withdraw/deposit on Account, synchronized dispense/canDispense on dispenser; ConcurrentHashMap for accounts (awesome-lld pattern); don’t lock the whole bank for unrelated accounts.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Names per-account and dispenser synchronization plus ConcurrentHashMap, not a global bank lock.

must_hit.point: Two ATMs, same account: bank-side locking / optimistic balance check; local synchronized on one ATM’s demo map is not enough for a real fleet; fleet scale (if asked): ATM is thin client, bank/switch owns ledger, local inventory eventually reconciled via operator + settlement logs.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Escalates from single-ATM locks to bank-side consistency for multi-ATM same-account.

probes: Two ATMs hit the same account — what protects the balance?
Can an operator refill cassettes while a withdrawal is in progress?

hints.1: Think one customer session on one machine, shared bank across machines.
hints.2: Session-lock the ATM; synchronize Account and CashDispenser separately.
hints.3: synchronized Account debit/credit + synchronized canDispense/dispense; ConcurrentHashMap accounts; fleet needs bank-side locking, not only local demo maps.

tradeoffs.topic: Enum FSM vs State pattern classes
tradeoffs.strong_answer: Enum + switch is faster to code; State classes win OCP when interviewers add Maintenance / CardBlocked / OutOfCash. Prefer State in OOD rounds (same lesson as vending machine).

tradeoffs.topic: Greedy COR vs DP for notes
tradeoffs.strong_answer: Greedy largest-first matches interview demos and canonical denominations; mention DP / alternate strategies if denominations are awkward or minimize note count under stock constraints is probed.
Industry ATM flows debit (or hold) then dispense; must reverse on hardware failure. Never leave debited but no cash without a recovery path.
OK for one physical machine demo; prefer DI for tests / multi-ATM fleets.

gotchas.trap: Withdraw before PIN / withdraw from Idle
gotchas.correction: State rejects; only Authenticated (or PINEntered) allows txns — never allow withdraw from Idle.
Lock card / retain; reset attempts on success; transition to Idle after eject.

gotchas.trap: ATM has total cash ≥ amount but wrong denominations (e.g. need $30 with only $20s)
gotchas.correction: canDispense fails even if total cash ≥ amount; don’t debit.
Reverse credit + error screen; log for operator; don’t eject until safe (senior probe: card retention ordering).

gotchas.trap: God-class ATM with nested if (state) × if (op)
gotchas.correction: State pattern is the expected fix — transitions belong in state classes via changeState.

gotchas.trap: Using double for cash or skipping dry-run and overdrafting the cassette
gotchas.correction: Prefer integer minor units; dry-run canDispense before debit; fail closed rather than partial silent dispense unless product asks.

gotchas.trap: Two ATMs, same account — only local synchronized on one ATM’s demo map
gotchas.correction: Need bank-side locking / optimistic balance check; local map sync is not enough for a real fleet.

gotchas.trap: Adding ₹200 notes or a new txn type by editing IdleState / ATM switch
gotchas.correction: New NoteDispenser link in chain / new Transaction + operation enum; no edit to IdleState.
